title: docs(plugin-gantt): the drag's time-of-day sentence names the shift-band exception (objectui#10866)
body:
Fixes #10866

Clause-②: no

The "Drag-and-drop rescheduling" bullet in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` said a drag keeps each date's time of day across a daylight-saving change, with no exception. With shift bands configured via `timeSegments`, a day-view drag goes by bands instead and a move keeps the bar's elapsed length. The sentence now says so. This is the docs PR of maintainer ruling 5890704219 on objectui#10866 (letter A): the shift-band scale keeps its elapsed-time arithmetic, and the docs name the exception, matching the qualifier `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md` already carries (recorded by review 5887794165, item 8). The ruling's re-entry condition goes on the card when this lands.

## What changed

One file, 3 insertions and 1 deletion: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx`. The clause "keeps each date's time of day across a daylight-saving change" gains "(with shift bands configured via `timeSegments`, a day-view drag goes by bands instead, and a move keeps the bar's elapsed length)". The rest of the bullet and its line wrapping are untouched. No code, no README edit, no changeset.

## The sentence against the code (objectui origin/main 5b2ea1757)

Read in `packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx`, cited by symbol:

- `computeDragChanges`: when the view is the day view and `shiftSegments` has at least one band, a `move` sets the start with `shift(originStart, unitDelta)` and moves the end by the same elapsed milliseconds the start moved; `resize-left` and `resize-right` shift the dragged edge with the same `shift` and floor the bar at the smallest band's duration. Every other scale takes the calendar-day path (`addUnits`, time of day kept). That is the branch the sentence excepts.
- On this scale `shift` is `shiftByWorkingColumns`, which walks the band column starts (`colStartMs`) and re-adds the offset inside the column. Bands are laid end to end by elapsed milliseconds, so the step is elapsed time, as ruling 5890704219 says.
- The pointer handler measures a step in the smallest band's width on this scale, and `shift` moves that many band columns.

The wording is "a drag goes by bands" (move and both edges) and "a move keeps the bar's elapsed length" (an edge resize changes the length, so the second clause is about a move only). The README's sentence sits in a paragraph about moves, and it carries the same meaning.
